description:
Split an SDLC plan into GitHub issues. Supports dryRun (default TRUE) - preview mode.

SAFETY: dryRun defaults to true. You MUST explicitly pass dryRun:false to create issues.

Dry-run output is designed to work as a human pre-write confirmation page: it includes a per-issue
preview (title/labels/truncated body), warnings for issues missing labels, missing/short bodies, or
titles exceeding GitHub's 256-character limit, and the exact repo coordinates that would be written to.

Args:
  - owner, repo: Repository coordinates.
  - titlePrefix (string?): Prefix for every issue title.
  - issues (array): 1-50 issues, each with title, body, labels?, assignees?. Accepts plan_from_context's issueDrafts directly.
  - dryRun (boolean): Default true - preview mode only.

Optional recovery controls belong in request params._meta["io.github.SakuraCianna/agentic-sdlc-mcp/issue-recovery"], never tool arguments:
  - idempotencyKey: 1-128 ASCII characters matching [A-Za-z0-9._:-]+. Use the same key in preview and live metadata and reuse the complete payload when resuming.
  - previewDigest: The 64-character lowercase hex digest from the reviewed preview. Mismatches cause zero writes.
The metadata value is a strict object with only those optional fields. Invalid recovery metadata is rejected before GitHub access. Other tool arguments retain their legacy ignored-extra-field behavior.

Returns: Confirmed created/reused issue numbers, per-input created/reused/failed/unknown/pending status and recovery guidance, or a preview + digest. Cancellation stops new writes but cannot establish whether an in-flight write committed. Idempotency recovery checks at most 300 issues including closed ones and fails closed for missing inputs when evidence is incomplete. Markers are correlation data, not authorization; concurrent processes and restarts cannot guarantee exactly-once writes. SDLC_READ_ONLY=true rejects live writes.

dryRun.description: If true (default), preview issues without creating them.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Optional acceptance criteria metadata from plan_from_context.

goal.description: Optional parent goal metadata from plan_from_context.

phase.description: Optional SDLC phase metadata from plan_from_context.

owner.description: GitHub owner. Falls back to GITHUB_OWNER.

repo.description: GitHub repo. Falls back to GITHUB_REPO.

titlePrefix.description: Optional prefix prepended to every issue title.

name: create_issue_set

count.description: Number of issues previewed or known successful issue references, including previously confirmed issues during recovery.

dryRun.description: Whether this was a preview-only run.

failures.description: Rejected or unconfirmed writes. Inspect items to distinguish failed from unknown commit status. Empty in dry run and on full success.

inputIndex.description: Zero-based index in the input issues array.

issues.description: Known successful issue references (empty in dry run). Inspect items for newly created, reused, or no longer verified references.

items.description: Per-input live results. Unknown means the write may have committed; pending means no request started.

preview.description: Per-issue preview (title, labels, truncated body) -- populated in dry run only.

previewDigest.description: Digest binding the complete ordered issue payload, target repository and optional request-metadata idempotencyKey. Return it as previewDigest inside request params._meta['io.github.SakuraCianna/agentic-sdlc-mcp/issue-recovery'], never tool arguments.

recovery.description: Recovery guidance. Even with a key, cross-process races and server restarts cannot guarantee exactly-once creation.

targetRepo.description: Repository targeted by the preview or live batch.

warnings.description: Human-review flags, e.g. missing labels, overlong title, missing/short body.

title: Create GitHub Issue Set
